blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Julia Coronel is embracing her learnings as the newest Capital1 member after three pressure-packed games in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Coronel came off the bench with 13 excellent sets and scored two of her three points, as Capital1 edged ZUS Coffee, 20-25, 25-17, 22-25, 25-20, 15-8, on Tuesday at Mall of Asia Arena. “I think, of course, I’m one of the new members who joined the team, along with Vanie and Ate Erika.
